title: Community alpha.3 anonymous inline preview contract lock (web portal prerequisite)
objective: Lock the owner-commissioned web-portal GAP-1 prerequisite as Community 0.1.0-alpha.3: one additive anonymous inline preview operation (GET /v1/resources/{resourceId}/versions/{versionId}/preview) with per-request published visibility, inline image/png bytes and security headers no weaker than the locked download surface, so the P3 public portal (future MCP-F2-COMMUNITY-002) and its first real community-sdk consumer can render cover images.
